name: Breethe
reason: Condition-led: breethe.com presents itself as an all-in-one mental wellness app ("Feel better. Sleep better."), led by easing anxiety and helping sleep, with hypnotherapy sessions as a main content type; almost nothing on its own site can be described without sleep, anxiety or therapy claims. Founder and lead teacher Lynne Goldberg has a Spiritpedia plan (lynne-goldberg). Owner may revisit, since Calm-style apps are allowed on practice-only terms.
